text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Asahi Hai F.S. has arrived. I'm in the waiting room, when…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, do we still have time? I'm out of tape.
choice_data_list: Now that you mention it, why do you always put tape on your nose?
Now that you mention it, why do you always put tape on your nose?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't feel right without it. Can't even remember when I started doing it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Anyway, can I go buy some tape? I can probably just pick some up at a convenience store since they sell everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's probably true, but Narita Brian has already changed clothes for the race. She'll definitely stand out if she goes out like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's also not good to waste time with stuff like this right before a race.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy it for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The quality doesn't matter, just get the cheapest one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just to be sure, I check what brand she usually uses before heading to the shop nearest to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The shelves contain a variety of brands, from well-established standbys to new products claiming to enhance concentration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's even scented tape for relaxation, and others that stretch.
choice_data_list: I don't know which one to pick…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What the heck? Did you buy out the whole store or something?
choice_data_list: …I'm paying for it, so don't worry about it.
…I'm paying for it, so don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's not the point. Geez.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: First of all, a trainer's contract only lasts for three years from the debut race. And if you don't get the results, that contract can even be terminated early.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yet you're out here wasting money buying stacks of tape. What are you going to do if I go on a losing streak and you lose your contract?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Huh?
choice_data_list: You're going to win, no matter who you're up against!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha… What's with the blind faith? Did you hit your head or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Hmph. Well? Which tape is the best for concentration?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll try that one first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …It feels okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is racing. The first across the finish line wins, right?
choice_data_list: You're going to win, no matter who you're up against!
You're going to win, no matter who you're up against!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Don't try and make me say that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Okay, fine… Whoever I'm up against, I'm going to tear them apart—victory will be mine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's a lotta people here. I'd expect nothin' less of the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, Brian! Don't bore us out there or I'll come laugh in your face when you're done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Asahi Hai F.S. is set to begin under the watchful eyes of a huge crowd.
